name: loki_compactor_not_running_compaction
title: Loki compactor not running compaction
description: The Loki compactor has not completed a successful compaction in over 3 hours (or never since startup), leaving index growth unbounded and retention unenforced.

source.upstream_query: min(time() - (loki_boltdb_shipper_compact_tables_operation_last_successful_run_timestamp_seconds > 0)) by (cluster, namespace) > 10800 or max(max_over_time(loki_boltdb_shipper_compact_tables_operation_last_successful_run_timestamp_seconds[3h])) by (cluster, namespace) == 0
source.upstream_description: The Loki compactor in {{ $labels.namespace }} has not completed a successful compaction in over 3 hours (or never since startup), leaving index growth unbounded and retention unenforced.
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

notes: 3-hour threshold is a rough default; depends on your ingestion volume and configured compaction schedule — adjust based on your workload.
